title: Working on my vehicle-building game and completely lost my objectivity. Not Astra =)
author: Responsible_Spot9894
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been staring at this project for so long that dev blindness has fully set in. I honestly can't tell what looks smooth and what looks straight-up janky anymore.

Looking for some completely fresh eyes:

* Does anything in the visuals or physics feel noticeably clunky?
* Is the gameplay feel coming across well, or does it look off?

Tear it apart — honest feedback is much appreciated!

PS: Gemini helped with coding =)

comments.author: Responsible_Spot9894
comments.body:
Thanks for checking it out, guys!

Quick heads-up: I'm wrapping up the Steam build for a playtest in the next couple of days.

If anyone wants to get hands-on and try this game, shoot me a DM or leave a comment here, and I'll send over a Steam key as soon as it go live.
